run_steps.name: run-01-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlretrieve('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/munimtechnologies/psp-five-minute-test/a025a506d2092e982e82e87c2c27e4f2a477fa98/psp5min/p5min.py', 'p5min.py')" && python -m py_compile p5min.py psp5alf.py test_psp5alf.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; sha256sum p5min.py psp5alf.py test_psp5alf.py PREREG-ALF-v0.1.md | tee /out/sha256.txt; pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '^(numpy|cdflib) ' | tee /out/versions.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-02-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m unittest -v test_psp5alf > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-03-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python psp5alf.py --data-dir /data --out-dir /out --budget-s 12000 > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^PALF_(VERSION|PERIHELIA|TIMECHECK|PUBLISHED|A1|A2|COUNTS|GRADES|BUDGET|WARN|ENC)' /out/run.txt | head -n 150; tail -n 30 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
